propositions: Code review must compile and execute DiscoveryStagePlan units from CriteriaSnapshot, respecting effective disables, project applicability, activated DET criteria, and authored budget constraints instead of ignoring them.

Each built-in and project criterion must execute at most once per Round A; project LLM criteria select by effective globs; disabled or non-applicable criteria execute zero times with stored reason provenance.

When one criterion fails locally, later independent criteria must continue executing and earlier successes must be retained; blocking-capable missing coverage yields INDETERMINATE unless a real block exists.
Positive authored usd_budget must be enforced and shed units recorded before calls; zero budget is schema-invalid; omission leaves no implicit cap.
Versioned safe discovery trace must persist in internal code-review journal only, never in public review response or status projection; public shape and backward compatibility preserved.

Approved differences between legacy and new projections are limited to effective disable/retune, project DET inclusion, project applicability, explicit budget enforcement, and partial-failure verdict policy.
